assessment_summary.project_name: Elbow Duct with Turning Vanes CFD
assessment_summary.cou_name: Early HVAC elbow sizing: predict pressure loss K and downstream flow distribution for AHU-7 retrofit

evidence_keywords: Mesh refinement study
K_coarse = 0.37
p_obs ≈ 1.92 for K
Extrapolated K_ext ≈ 0.345
estimated discretization band on fine grid ≈ 1.2%
Convergence targets: scaled residuals below 1e-5 for continuity and momentum
steady monitors of section-averaged static pressure at taps varying less than 0.2%
Mass residuals balanced to within 0.05% at convergence
starting from uniform vs precursor-patched initial fields resulted in the same K within 0.3%
Appropriateness of physics
The flows considered are subsonic, incompressible
k-omega SST with low-Re wall treatment
This is a simplification but captures first-order roughness drag.
Boundary and initial conditions
inlet turbulence intensity 5% (baseline)
ks = 0.1 mm
sensitivity explored 2% and 10%
doubling ks to 0.2 mm increased K by 2.1%
Environment stabilized at 20 ± 1 °C.
air properties and bulk velocity were matched to within 0.5%
The downstream tap plane in the model was positioned to coincide
12 Dh conditioning section with honeycomb and two screens.
Matching simulation to test
matched to within 0.5% of the test conditions
inlet turbulence intensity is not measured in the lab upstream of the elbow module
we include ±1.5% as roughness-induced spread
Pressure loss coefficient
Measured K at 1.8 m3/s: 0.358 ± 0.007
CFD fine grid K at 1.8 m3/s: 0.349 ± 0.004
Difference: −2.6% relative to measurement mean
Spatial correlation coefficient between CFD and PIV velocity magnitude on the downstream plane: 0.94
